description: This Java class, ProductReviewController, is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing administrative review functionalities for products, including displaying reviews, paginating review data, and removing reviews within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ProductReviewController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing product reviews in the admin panel, including review listing, pagination, and deletion.

methods.name: displayProductReviews
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display product reviews page for a specific product, with validation checks to ensure product exists and belongs to the current store.

methods.name: pageProductReviews
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated review data for a product, returning reviews in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product review, with authorization validation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set menu attributes in the model for navigation display.
